checks.questionEn: If the known lift changes from0.2x to ax, what remains exact and what still needs validation?
checks.questionZh: 已知延拓从零点二 x 改为 a x 后，什么仍然精确，什么仍需要验证？
checks.answerEn: For any known constant a, the reference ax+1-x²-y² has source4 because the linear lift has zero Laplacian. On the unit circle the quadratic correction vanishes, so g+phi*N matches ax for every network parameter value. This boundary identity does not guarantee the learned interior field is accurate. The raw exact-distance factor still has a centre cusp; changing the lift cannot repair its missing second derivative. Run any changed configuration into a separate record and compare full-disk error, shifted rim values and centre derivatives.
checks.answerZh: 对任意已知常数 a，参考解 ax+1-x²-y² 的热源仍是四，因为线性延拓的拉普拉斯为零。单位圆周上二次修正消失，所以任意网络参数下，g+φN 都匹配 ax。这个边界恒等式不能保证内部学习场准确。真实距离因子的圆心尖点仍存在；改变延拓无法修复缺失的二阶导数。修改实验时另存记录，比较全圆盘误差、错开圆周值及圆心导数。
